Gap-side recurrence uses gap(m) offset: G(m,n)=G(m-1,n)+G(m-gap,n-m). Mod-side uses M(m,n)=M(m-1,n)+M(m-1,n-m). Different recurrences → cannot prove by matching.
Three viable proof strategies remain: (a) direct bijection, (b) GF identity at power series level, (c) clever variable substitution

Session 6 assessment: GF infrastructure (partGF, geomSeries convolution, coeff recursion) is solid at 3052 lines. The Schur identity proof requires showing ∏(1+x^k, k≢0 mod 3) = ∏(1/(1-x^j), j≡1,2 mod 3). This is a standard q-series identity but formalizing it needs ~500+ lines of algebraic manipulation.
The key identity: ∏_{k not div by 3}(1+x^k) = ∏_{k not div by 3}(1-x^{2k})/(1-x^k). The numerator ∏(1-x^{2k}) cancels factors from the denominator, leaving ∏ 1/(1-x^k) for k≡1,2 mod 3.
